title: Which key has this rank?
hook: A tree can skip keys it never visits.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
Binary search-tree ordering; subtree size and interval notation.
doesNotKnow: Use subtree sizes to select a rank without walking all preceding keys.

misconception: A search tree can search values but cannot jump to a rank.
objective: Use subtree sizes to select a rank without walking all preceding keys.

claims.text: Each subtree annotation counts its nodes. Going right skips the entire left subtree and the current key, so the remaining local rank must shrink by exactly that skipped amount.
